newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish tele operator sets issue, eyes listing.
newsitem.headline: Finnish tele operator sets issue, eyes listing.

text.p: Finnish telecoms network operator Helsingin Puhelin Oy said in a statement on Monday it would launch a rights issue of seven million new series E shares and apply for a listing of these shares on the Helsinki bourse.
Helsingin Puhelin said it would offer shares to members of the Helsingin Puhelinyhdistys cooperative (HPY). Each membership certificate would entitle the holder to subscribe 10 new series E shares.
If all shares were subscribed, HPY would retain 85.2 percent of shares and 96 percent of votes in Helsingin Puhelin, the company said.
Finnish state-owned commercial bank Postipankki Oy would be lead manager of the share issue.
Helsingin Puhelin said it would apply for a listing of its E share on the Helsinki bourse before September 12.
It said it expected bourse trade in the share to start around November 25.
